## Scope

Describe the single problem solved and anything intentionally left out.

## Tests

List the exact sequential commands run and their results.

## Impact checklist

- [ ] I assessed memory, CPU, process, and startup resource impact.
- [ ] I removed secrets and reviewed security and privacy impact.
- [ ] I updated documentation and `CHANGELOG.md`, or explained why neither changes.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO sign-off created with `git commit -s`.
- [ ] The change preserves native, no-sudo, bounded, and reversible behavior.
